column1: # Dutch (nl) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format as es.tsv:
# context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Dutch video-editing vocabulary (tijdlijn, track, clip, reeks, bin, afspeelkop, markering,
# overgang, keyframe). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was
# consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands use the infinitive ("Opslaan als…"),
# labels use sentence case, and product and format names (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep
# their spelling. Decimal comma (0,5). A native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = clip, track = track, sequence = reeks, timeline = tijdlijn, bin = bin, playhead =
# afspeelkop, marker = markering, In/Out point = in-/uitpunt, keyframe = keyframe, caption =
# ondertitel, preset = voorinstelling, workspace = werkruimte, gain = versterking, opacity =
# dekking, render = renderen, ripple = ripple, dissolve = overvloeier, wipe = veeg, highlights =
# hooglichten, frame hold = stilstaand beeld, (Legacy) = (verouderd).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see nl.tsv.attribution.
